alana: opened PR 5632 with a short how-to for dashboard cost + tracehook examples. asking for quick SDK snippet sanity checks and a link sweep: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5632
sam: I'll take ruby + python.
jess: I'll do the JS and console screenshots.
mike: can you paste the ruby snippet here? want to run it in CI container.
sam: snippet:
```ruby
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.kv_prefetch(prefix: 'user:', limit: 100)
puts resp.keys[0,5]
```
sam: found one minor naming inconsistency: our SDK method is kv.prefetch (dot) not kv_prefetch. i'll push a tiny fix.
jess: JS example: changed to async with abort handling and updated param names.
jess: also the screenshot capture had an old legend label; updated the alt text and screenshot file.
